newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains feedlot markets quiet - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains feedlot markets quiet - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot markets were quiet Thursday with most showlists sold out during active trading Tuesday, feedlot sources said.

Shipments of the Tuesday sales began Wednesday and will continue through Friday. The quick delivery of this week's sales bolstered the confidence of feedlot managers, who expect meat packers to be back in the market early next week.
Next week's cattle offerings were expected to be priced at $68.00 per cwt, $2.00 higher than this week's sales at $66.00.
Feedlots are very current with most of this week's sales originally scheduled for late December and early January showlists.
Also, several feedlots said next week's showlists will be small and will contain short-fed cattle.
